Buy from **B - Ottervale Audio** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/wfx5jh/b

It's the same headphones from both sellers:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite**

Here's the comparison:

|  | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | **$129.00** | **$142.00** |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. |
| **Warranty / Authenticity** | 1-year limited warranty. No mention of authorized dealer | **Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.** + 1-year limited warranty |

Everything except price and warranty is identical - same model, specs, box contents, shipping speed, return policy, and rating.

Why pay $13 more for B:

1.  **Full manufacturer warranty you can actually use.** B explicitly states it's an Authorized Quellwyn dealer with Full manufacturer warranty. A only says "1-year limited warranty" with no authorized status - that is likely a seller-only warranty, and Quellwyn could refuse service if it's grey-market / not from an authorized source.

2.  **Authenticity peace of mind.** For electronics like noise-cancelling headphones, counterfeit or grey-import risk is real. Authorized dealer status is the guarantee you're getting a genuine new unit.

The $13 saving from A - Brackmoor Sound - isn't worth the risk of having no manufacturer support if they break in the next year.

If you are extremely price-sensitive and willing to accept that risk, A is cheaper for the identical item on paper. But for most buyers, B is the safer buy.
